localChanges: The world wraps but the box showing what the portal is looking at did not, so centring near an edge drew it running off that side with nothing coming back on the opposite one — a viewport that was plainly half missing. `rawVisibleRange()` is unwrapped by design, so the box is now drawn from its wrapped origin and again a world earlier on whichever axis overflows. The copies' outer edges fall off the canvas, so the two halves meet without a seam. This was the `TODO: draw the rectangle replicated when close to the sides` that sat on the old rect.
Both edges are floored now rather than the width being floored on its own, so a box covers the same tiles however it is split.
